question: What are the names and ids of all makers with more than 3 models?

question: Show the years in which orchestras that have given more than one performance are founded.
issue_sql:
SELECT orchestra.Year_of_Founded
FROM orchestra
WHERE orchestra.Conductor_ID IN (
    SELECT conductor.Conductor_ID
    FROM conductor
    JOIN performance ON conductor.Conductor_ID = performance.Orchestra_ID
    JOIN show ON performance.Performance_ID = show.Performance_ID
    GROUP BY conductor.Conductor_ID
    HAVING orchestra.Year_of_Founded > (SELECT MAX(Year_of_Founded) FROM orchestra)
) AND orchestra.Orchestra_ID IN (
    SELECT Orchestra_ID
    FROM orchestra
    GROUP BY Orchestra_ID
    HAVING COUNT(Orchestra_ID) > 1
);

question: What is the first, middle, and last name, along with the id and number of enrollments, for the student who enrolled the most in any program?
issue_sql:
SELECT 
    s.first_name, 
    s.middle_name, 
    s.last_name, 
    s.student_enrolment_id, 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN s.student_enrolment_id IN (SELECT student_enrolment_id FROM Student_Enrolment_Courses) ELSE 0 END) AS enrollments
FROM Students s
JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses sc ON s.student_id = sc.student_course_id
JOIN Student_Enrolment ON sc.student_enrolment_id = sc.student_enrolment_id
GROUP BY s.first_name, s.middle_name, s.last_name, s.student_enrolment_id
ORDER BY enrollments DESC
LIMIT 1;
